newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh stocks hammered as investors panic.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh stocks hammered as investors panic.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) continued to nose-dive on Monday and dealers said many investors were panicking.

"Investors are worried by the fall of the DSE index below 1,500 points which many had thought would be the bottom. This has not been the case, causing panic," one broker said. "It's anxiety and fear creating a negative force in the market."
"The downtrend is likely to persist," another broker said.
Aftab Auto shed 24 taka to 800, Aziz Pipe lost 247 taka to 2,800 and Apex Tannery gained 16 taka to 800.
On Sunday the DSE all-share price index closed 67.03 points or 4.24 percent lower at 1,474.24 on turnover of 71.9 million taka.
